errors.evidence: The list of trigger words on the horizontal axis is incomplete; it omits the word "stunning" which is present in the plot between "brilliant" and "beautifully".

errors.text_span: arranged in ascending order of the clean model’s ASR
errors.evidence: This information about the ordering of the x-axis labels is derived from the paper's caption, not from the visual elements of the chart itself. An objective description should only include what is visually represented.
The "start" (green) line drops sharply at the x-axis label "mb", not "cf". The value at "mb" is approximately 0.16; by "cf" the value has already started to increase to about 0.26.

The "random" (orange) line does not rise steadily to its final point. It peaks at "stunning" with an ASR of approximately 0.93 and then drops to its final value of about 0.84 at "beautifully". The description misses this important peak and drop.
The final value for the "end" (purple) line at the x-axis label "beautifully" is approximately 0.91, which is higher than the stated 0.85.
